_readme: Scene plan for SOCH. Times are on the PLANNED timeline (config planned_timeline); the editor remaps them to the real song (actual_timeline) and snaps cuts to the 96 BPM beat grid. '@rishi' refers to the character reference image (assets/character_reference/). If you use a tool without reference support, delete '@rishi, ' and keep the description. Clip file for each scene: assets/generated_clips/<id>.mp4. Text-to-video does NOT produce accurate Hindi lip-sync: scenes with needs_lipsync=true should go through a dedicated lip-sync tool (see README).
